UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,
Plaintiff,
V.

The Honorable Judge
Rossie D. Alston Jr.
KATIE HALL, individually;
NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN;
META PLATFORMS, INC.;
and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,
Defendants.
NOTICE OF FILING AMENDED PROOF OF SERVICE
AS TO DEFENDANT META PLATFORMS, INC.
Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine, pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 4(1)(3), files
this amended proof of service as to Defendant Meta Platforms, Inc., and states as follows:
1. On July 31, 2026, Meta Platforms, Inc. was served with the summons directed to it and
the Complaint through its registered agent, CSC Lawyers Incorporating Service, by delivery to
Rebecca Vang, Associate Intake Coordinator, at 2710 Gateway Oaks Drive, Suite 150N,
Sacramento, California 95833. The process was served by Demian Ross, who executed a proof of
service under penalty of perjury.
2. The proof of service reflecting that service was docketed at ECF No. 4. As the Clerk
noted, the summons page assembled as the first page of ECF No. 4 was a summons form directed to

Defendant Katie Hall. The sworn proof of service appearing as the second page of ECF No. 4
concerns the service of Meta Platforms, Inc.
3. The misassembly was confined to the return as filed. The process served upon Meta
Platforms, Inc. on July 31, 2026 comprised the summons directed to Meta Platforms, Inc. and the
Complaint. No summons directed to Defendant Katie Hall was served upon Meta Platforms, Inc.
4. Plaintiff files herewith the corrected return, attaching the summons directed to Meta
Platforms, Inc. together with the server's sworn proof of service. This filing corrects the proof of
service only.
5. Under Rule 4(1)(3), the failure to file a conforming proof of service does not affect the
validity of service, and the Court may permit proof of service to be amended. Service upon Meta
Platforms, Inc. was effected on July 31, 2026, and Meta Platforms, Inc.'s deadline to respond to the
Complaint remains August 21, 2026.
Date: August 20, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847
Alexandria, Virginia 22307
(407) 794-6503
jayballentine@protonmail.com

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I certify that on August 20, 2026, I submitted the foregoing Notice, together with the
corrected return attached hereto, to the Clerk of Court through the Court's Electronic Document
Submission System for docketing on CM/ECF. Upon docketing, counsel for Defendant National
Center for Missing & Exploited Children will receive notice through the Court's CM/ECF system.
Pursuant to Federal Rules of Civil Procedure 5(a)(1) and 5(b)(2)(C), I served a true and correct
copy of the foregoing by first-class mail, postage prepaid, addressed as follows: Katie Hall, c/o
National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, 333 John Carlyle Street, Suite 125, Alexandria,
Virginia 22314; and Meta Platforms, Inc., c/o CSC - Lawyers Incorporating Service, 2710
Gateway Oaks Drive, Suite 150N, Sacramento, California 95833.
Marvelle J. Ballentine
